csv.filename_description: Index daily OHLCV CSVs laid out as <root>/YYYY/MM/DD.MM.YYYY_<infix>_OHLCV.csv (three-level: year, month, then the dated CSV directly — no symbol directory). The <infix> is a dataset tag (e.g. complete_df for futures, nifty_spot for spot) and is not constrained — any daily file shaped DD.MM.YYYY_<infix>_OHLCV.csv is accepted. One file per trading day; the dataset is a single index series so there is no ASK/BID split. Required columns: timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume. An optional vwap column ships per row and is preserved through to the returned dataframe. The scanner aggregates all daily files into one entry and presents it with a synthetic display name shaped like <SYMBOL>_DDMONYYYY_DDMONYYYY_LAST_OHLCV.csv (this is what filename_pattern matches — the source files themselves keep their DD.MM.YYYY_<infix>_OHLCV.csv name on disk). Symbol is derived from the root folder name (uppercased, non-alphanumerics replaced with underscore). Default root: D:\complete_df_yyyy.
